claim_scope: single-seed online same-distribution VDA4 competence test; not transfer or held-out evidence

architecture.visual_feedback: crossattn1: RMSNorm sources; Q=X; K/V=[X,H1_prev] under one inspectable softmax; per-head QK normalization
architecture.memory1: RMSNorm sources; Q=H1_prev; K/V=[H1_prev,Z]; four-head QK-normalized attention; K3-style output gate; raw H1 then tokenwise feature softmax
architecture.memory2: RMSNorm sources; Q=H2_prev; K/V=[H2_prev,H1]; four-head QK-normalized attention; K3-style output gate; raw H2 then tokenwise feature softmax
architecture.initial_memory: learned slot-distinct H1_0/H2_0 logits, tokenwise softmaxed before first use
architecture.softmax_axis: each token independently over its 128 memory features
architecture.attention_output_gate: bias-free full-rank sigmoid gate per query/head/channel after attention-times-value and before output projection

jepa.cross_entropy: temporal student@t predicts detached EMA-teacher@t+1 independently for H1/H2
jepa.student_output: structured prototype probabilities via feature-wise logits and student-temperature softmax in the JEPA objective
jepa.center_update: EMA over valid timesteps only; padded tails excluded

collapse_prevention.sinkhorn_knopp: 3 iterations; balanced independently per memory-layer/token/head over valid batch-time samples

curriculum.update: theta=max(theta_floor, theta-3deg) only when window correctness>=0.85

post_checkpoint_routing: memory attention by layer and head
